PASS WITH NOTES: PR #286, F199(c), FINAL ROUND 2 under C34
Head: c58deb2a58e5d86ab0b7493c6e2ac5833bca21fd
Current main base: 435245a67b97780d880cd29f82a377c448fca30f
Round-1 head: d55bb57caf09a5fe7d7d3a16226a7e1f90a1b922
Answers: 01a1f84f-7d7b-7262-a245-ba2fc4c9a551

B286-001 is repaired. No exploitable security vulnerability or new normal-use correctness regression was identified in the bounded repair review. No new C34 follow-up needs a pm-001 ruling, and no third review round is requested.

Dispositions and evidence

- B286-001 RESOLVED: .omp/extensions/pij/adapters/rust-runtime.ts:356-358,411-413,719-741 separates synchronous activityObserved from acknowledged activityPublished. Boot uses its own runtime's isIdle(); reportControlContext sends the current observation; publication acknowledgment updates only acknowledged state. Reattachment at 471-477 reports the latest observation after registration checking. Shutdown retains its acknowledgment-based repair guard.
- Four regressions were read in full at rust-runtime.test.ts:419-501: arming behind an in-flight idle; arming behind an in-flight working; reattachment/re-registration behind an in-flight working; and a new lifecycle's own boot state. Exact-head CI passed all 125 tests in this file. The packet's RED-on-d55bb57 claim was not independently rerun.
- Round-1 caller binding and admission conclusions remain valid: crates/daemon/src/http/fyi.rs:300-310,383-385,491-511 retains bound-seat recording and contradictory claims refusals; reported_context.rs:216-228 checks the recorded process incarnation. This remains registration-strength binding, not independent posting-process authentication, within C33.
- Warning-not-refusal semantics and delivery admission are unchanged. The bare-422 retry in .omp/extensions/pij/adapters/daemon-http.ts:276-300 removes only control_context, preserving activity and binding evidence.
- S286-001 REMAINS, previously accepted and nonblocking under C33: rust-runtime.ts:1230 still interpolates raw pane text from index.ts:479. Ordinary tmux %N is inert; a shell-copy scenario requires a deliberately altered trusted local launch environment plus human copying. Shared shell-word escaping remains a follow-up, not a new C34 finding. Only the daemon warning path uses shell_word, at crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:3002. Do not describe the extension path as escaped.
- docs/how/pij-rs-api.md:975 and docs/difficulties.md:197 accurately describe the reattachment trigger and the control map's lifetime: one retained entry per reporting seat ID since daemon boot, with the latest incarnation. No added secrets, private content or forbidden home paths were found in the repair/documentation delta; the round-1 privacy conclusion stands.

Scope

The requested comparison from 435245a6^1 to this head includes 18 files. Two queue files and the D-F234 ledger row belong to merged-main #285 and were excluded from re-review. The PR contribution against current main remains 16 files. This final round checked the repair, directly dependent behavior and prior notes, not an expanded audit.

Validation

- just pr-freeze 286: PASS / FINAL at the exact head, clean review worktree, main base, CLEAN merge, latest checks passed, ready, no migrations added, delivers CI passed.
- gh run view 44710347001 --repo AI-Substrate/pij-fleet --json headSha,conclusion,jobs: SUCCESS at the exact head; Node 22/24, Rust lint and Rust test jobs passed.
- Node 24 job 136200145994: rust-runtime.test.ts 125 PASS; daemon-http.test.ts 25 PASS; full TS suite 2366 passed, 7 skipped.
- Successful Rust job 136200145731 uploaded junit-linux artifact ID 14617127840; selected by its upload log, not by artifact name alone.
- No local test/build, dependency installation/linking, or full local harness-gate pass claimed. C25 exact-head CI proof was used. The authorized review worktree was left untouched.

Holding security/286 remains active until merge. This verdict answers the new round-2 request without releasing it.
